费用：户外散步没有展馆门票，开车入园另有车辆费用；CuriOdyssey、租赁与: Cost: the outdoor walk requires no museum ticket, but vehicle entry costs extra. CuriOdyssey, rentals and classes are charged separately.

三站可缩短，不必走完整圈: Three stops you can shorten at any point
海滨、码头与可选科学馆: Promenade, marina and an optional museum
先对照公园地图看停车点，三站之间可原路返回；展馆是独立加选。: Locate your parking area on the park map first. Retrace your route as needed; the museum is an optional separate visit.
从海滨长廊开始，在铺装路面上找一段视野开阔的位置看飞机和湾面。先走短程感受风，再: Start on the paved promenade with a clear view of aircraft and the bay. Take a short walk to assess the wind before going farther. Children can observe sails and birds. Shallow water is not an invitation to wade; beach time and water activities need separate checks of current conditions.
沿开放路径往码头方向走，看桅杆、船只和岸边水鸟，把这一段当作慢观察而非一定要走到: Follow open paths toward the marina to observe masts, boats and shoreline birds. There is no need to reach the end of the breakwater. Turn back if surfaces do not suit a wheelchair or stroller, keep away from water edges and leave birds undisturbed. Return to the parking area if the wind builds.
仍有精神且已核对票务，就把 CuriOdyssey 作为单独一段科学与动物观察；: If energy and ticket availability permit, make CuriOdyssey a separate science and wildlife visit. Check opening, admission and remaining visiting time before heading over. Otherwise rest in an open area and leave. Do not assume membership parking benefits apply throughout the park or take shortcuts through construction barriers.
风、亲子节奏与回程出口: Wind, family pacing and getting home
海滨遮挡有限，带防风外套、饮水和防晒，野餐选择现场允许使用的区域。雨天或风大时可: Bring a windproof layer, water and sun protection for the exposed waterfront, and picnic only in permitted open areas. In rain or strong wind, keep just a confirmed museum visit; CuriOdyssey also has outdoor areas. Work backward from park closing and return transit, allowing time to walk back from the water.
